productName: French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table
description:
The French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table gives you seven drawers and a changing table for daily diaper changes, all in one piece.

Below the changing table, seven dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide storage for clothing, bedding, diapers, and wipes. It is crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing.

The warm finishes and rustic charm coordinate with the full French Country collection for a beautifully cohesive nursery.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
